consular.mission: Canadian Embassy, Tunis; Australian High Commission, Malta
consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy in Tunisia. The Embassy of Canada in Tunis provides consular assistance to Australians in Tunisia. For passport and notarial services, please contact the Australian High Commission, Malta.
